strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
And so... you'll approach from the ground in your Aestivalis
and destroy the "Nanafushi"!
Use a formation of three Artillery and three Ground frames, please.
Why Artillery and Ground frames?
Can't we just zip over there in Aerial frames?
From the air, the Nanafushi's anti-air defense system
will shoot us down. Didn't I tell you?
Guess we'll just have to slog it out by land...
Akatsuki will lead the operation.
Roger~
All riiight! With my Aestivalis, the Jovian Lizards' big weapon
is going down!
Being fired up is fine, but you won't get so fired up
you run out of energy, will you?
The Nadesico can't move from this location,
so if you leave its supply range, you won't receive any energy.
No wasting it, then...
You've got batteries on board, but they don't last forever.
"We ran out of energy and never made it to the Nanafushi."
Don't you dare let it come to that.
We kno-ow~
Let's go! Tenkawa, quit dawdling!
H-Hang on a sec.
All riiight! Once we're near the Nanafushi, we just fire away, right?
Exactly.
Take the route that uses the least energy and go destroy the Nanafushi!
Did we get it?
Ngh, still not enough?
No way! We pumped a ton of shots into it!
Then it's time for my Gai Super Napper!
No, wait.
Daaah~!
What's wrong!? Gai!
Marching through a place with no enemies just ain't my style!
Now, don't say that. This is a perfectly respectable mission too.
No stage for a star? Then it's a no-show... Heh heh heh.
...Geez.
At this rate, we won't get to see Yamada in action~
If there's no call for us, isn't that fine?
I want something more, like...
Shh!
What is it, Izumi!?
They're coming!
Geez, quit turning into Serious Izumi out of nowhere.
There they are!
All riiight~ My time to shine~!
Calm down!
Huh? Why are you stopping me?
Our objective is the "Nanafushi," first and last.
Don't forget that.
So don't waste energy or ammo on the drones, right?
Yep, just like Tenkawa says. So, keep that in mind!
Is this it!?
Isn't that the Nadesico, Big Bro?
Oh? Could that be...?
This is Lieutenant Shiro Amada of the Gandor squad.
Nadesico, do you read me?
The Gandor squad?
If you can hear me, please respond!
This is the Nadesico's captain, Yurika Misumaru.
What are you from the Gandor squad doing in a place like this?
Admiral Misumaru was worried the Nadesico had been shot down.
So we got orders to find the Nadesico and destroy the Nanafushi.
Oh, I see... Father did that...
You're late! We already wrecked the Nanafushi a while ago!
Yep yep. More importantly, do something about the Gyandlar.
Pretty good timing, I'd say. We'll head out to destroy the Nanafushi!
You take care of the Lizards around us!
Now that reinforcements from the Gandor are here, we might manage.
Still... if it had to be someone, I wish my super robots had come...
That would've been great...
Now, now, don't say that.
Real robots are pretty great too, right? Like this Zaku, especially.
That's enough chatter.
Without the Mutron, there's no reason to stay here,
but I think I'll play around a little longer.
We came all this way. Let's give 'em a fight!
Everyone, whatever you do, don't get shot down by their anti-air fire!
If we could go by air, it'd be faster.
Five more minutes...
Five more minutes until what?
In five minutes, the Nanafushi's Micro Black Hole Cannon
will finish charging its energy.
Another direct hit from that Railgun... and it's over for the Nadesico.
What!? You should've told us sooner!
It can't be helped. I only just figured it out.
Then we just destroy the Nanafushi within five minutes. No problem.
You make it sound awfully easy.
Reinforcements from the Gandor are here, so I'm sure it'll work out.
Hope you're right!
1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed 2. Nanafushi not destroyed by turn 8
Huh...?
Yaaay~! Mission complete~!
The Nanafushi... has gone completely silent.
With that, the Nanafushi's long-range cannon is no longer a threat.
That's my Akito!
What about my heroics?
More of them!?
What the?
What's that...? So that huge energy reading wasn't the Mutron...
Mu... tron?
Hey... those enemies, aren't they...?
Enemy identified. It's the Gyandlar...
Geez! What on earth is Captain Bright doing!?
Enemies from space keep pouring in!
Even Londo Bell can't stop every single enemy, you know.
Isn't this turning out kind of bad?
Yeah... it sure is...
You're wrong! The Nadesico's broken down, in a pinch! Enemies closing in!
Kaaaah! Now that's a situation that gets my blood boiling!!
...Idiot.
The Nadesico isn't the only one that can't move!
Our Aestivalis are getting low on energy too, y'know?
We used too much energy on the Nanafushi... We won't last like this.
Ruri! How much longer until the Nadesico's repaired?
Not for a while. It's a wonder we're even alive...
Uuu...
What are we supposed to do...
I sent a distress signal to Commander Hazuki. They should be here soon.
I hope we can hold out until then.
1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
Oh, it's the Gandor!
Is everyone all right!?
Of course we are.
The Nadesico is... somehow all right too.
Looks like we made it in time.
Thank you for your help, Commander Hazuki!
Hey, you people! This is no time for a leisurely chat, is it!?
Did you forget the Gyandlar are here?
All right, let's launch!
We're already set to launch.
I'm counting on you! My super robots!
This is a great help, Captain.
Yes, with everyone from the Gandor here, I feel totally safe.
Out you come in droves... Let me test just how strong you are.
Hmm... Not bad! You truly are strong...
Looks like you underestimated us.
Hah hah hah, I hope we cross swords again... Gandor squad.
That should do. Playtime is over... I have no more business here...
Geez! One after another, honestly!
Screw it, I'm going all out!
Ryoko snapped!?
I leave the rest to you.
Gadessa!
Kaaah! Did you hear that, Akito!? "A burning soul cuts down evil!"
I wanna make an entrance like that tooooo!
S-Sure, it's cool no matter how many times I see it... but doing it myself...
Those are the people we met on Mars before.
Rom Stol!?
You're... the ones we met on Mars?
Yes... Thank you for your help back then.
You know them, Yurika?
Rom and his friends helped us once before on Mars, too...
Are they the mystery reinforcements Captain Bright told us about...?
This is no time for a leisurely talk.
We must wipe out the enemy... We'll lend you our strength.
Thank you for your help. Captain Misumaru, are you ready?
Yes. Now that Rom and his friends are here, let's ride this momentum!
So you've come, Blue Jet.
We meet again. Shall we continue our fight from space?
I'd love to... or so I'd like to say, but...
Running away!?
As an officer of the Gyandlar, I too have duties to fulfill...
Farewell, Blue Jet.
Good work, Akito!
Good work, Akito!
It's finally over...
They sure were persistent.
Well, that's how it goes when I'm on the job! Gwahahahaha!
If you say so...
Who exactly are you...?
I don't want to drag the people of Earth into needless trouble...
For now, let's just say we're the ones pursuing the Gyandlar...
Captain Bright told me a little about you, but...
Bright...? Oh, that Londo Bell captain?
I hear you're a mysterious gentleman who comes and goes like the wind.
Lucky you, Leina. He called you a gentleman.
Geez, how rude. I'm a lady.
He means you're a wild tomboy, right?
Driiill...
Now, now, milady.
Here on Earth, there are many enemy forces, the Gyandlar included,
whose goals are unknown. Would you be willing to help us?
Of course, as one who wishes for peace in space, I'll gladly help,
but we also have our own mission to pursue the Gyandlar.
Brother, we should get going...
It seems the Gyandlar's goal lies here on Earth.
I'm sure we'll meet again. Farewell.
See ya. Jeeeet!
Just as Captain Bright said... a man of many mysteries...
He certainly doesn't seem like a bad person, though.
He said they were pursuing the Gyandlar, but...
